# Routine Gen

> Routine Gen (https://routinegen.vercel.app) is an open, free, 100% client-side academic routine and college timetable generator with automated teacher clash detection, multi-period lab allocation, and Excel/PDF export capabilities.

## Overview
Routine Gen simplifies academic schedule planning for universities, colleges, departments, and schools. All scheduling logic runs strictly inside the user's browser using client-side JavaScript. Zero institutional data, teacher names, or student rosters are ever sent to an external server or cloud database.

## Core Capabilities
- **Clock-Minute Conflict Resolution**: Computes schedule clashes using exact clock-time intervals rather than arbitrary period slots, enabling different semesters to follow independent start times, class lengths, and break timings.
- **Multi-Period Lab Support**: Intelligently allocates theory (1 period), extended theory (2 periods), mini labs (1 period), extended labs (2 periods), and hybrid theory+lab blocks without teacher overlaps.
- **Bulk Excel Import & Export**: Supports an all-in-one 3-sheet Excel format (`.xlsx`/`.xls`) covering Departments & Timings (Sheet 1), Subjects & Labs (Sheet 2), and Teachers Directory (Sheet 3).
- **JSON Routine Importer**: Enables developers and administrators to paste structured timetable JSON and catch teacher conflicts in real time with one-click auto-placement.
- **Progressive Web App (PWA)**: Works 100% offline via Service Worker caching and is installable on Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS.
- **Printer-Ready PDF Export**: Generates high-resolution vector PDF schedules individually or in bulk via jsPDF.

## Core Tools & Pages
- [Main Routine Generator](https://routinegen.vercel.app/): Interactive 4-step wizard to configure bell settings, departments, semesters, teachers, and generate routines.
- [User Guide & Excel Documentation](https://routinegen.vercel.app/help.html): Comprehensive tutorial, Excel template download, JSON anatomy, and FAQs.
- [JSON Routine Importer](https://routinegen.vercel.app/json-import.html): Dedicated JSON routine validator, live conflict resolver, and busy teacher grid.
- [Full LLM Context & Schemas](https://routinegen.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Complete technical specification, column rules, JSON schema, and algorithm details.
